pe_prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D CG cute-pet comedy skit, vertical composition, a static shot with a very slow push-in at slow speed frames a golden retriever puppy on the left and a ragdoll cat on the right sitting side by side at a wooden school desk in a bright classroom, exactly as shown in <Picture 1> — the cat with white/cream fur, blue eyes, a pink satin bow and multi-strand pearl necklace, the dog with fluffy golden fur, front paws on the desk, soft daylight from the window with a beige curtain, and the watermark "豆包AI生成" in the bottom-right corner. At the start, the cat raises a paw slightly and speaks toward the front as if addressing the teacher; the cheerful young female voice with a Sichuan accent (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 老师我想换座位</d> while a subtitle reading "老师我想换座位" appears at the bottom of the frame. At 00:02.500, both pets hold their poses, the cat looking expectantly forward with a small head tilt, and an off-screen female teacher's voice (S2) asks: <d>[Chinese] 为什么呀</d> with the subtitle "为什么呀" displayed. At 00:05.000, the cat turns its head slightly toward the dog with a disdainful expression and says: <d>[Chinese] 我旁边坐了一只傻狗</d> with the subtitle "我旁边坐了一只傻狗", while the dog's ears perk up. At 00:07.500, the dog turns its head toward the cat with slight bark-like mouth movement and no distortion; the young male voice with a Sichuan accent (S3) retorts: <d>[Chinese] 你旁边才坐了只傻狗</d> with the subtitle "你旁边才坐了只傻狗". At 00:10.000, the dog gives a small emphatic head bob and repeats: <d>[Chinese] 大傻狗</d> with the subtitle "大傻狗", while the cat's expression droops. At 00:12.500, the cat shakes its head, raises a paw to cover its face, and sighs with its shoulders dropping, while the dog looks smugly forward; the frame settles on this two-shot composition matching <Picture 1>. All positions, fur, bow, and necklace remain consistent throughout with no morphing or ghosting.

overall_soundscape: A quiet classroom ambience with a faint room tone and soft rustle of fur and paws on the wooden desk. A small paw tap, a gentle canine huff during the retort, and a long feline sigh with a subtle fabric-like rustle at the end.

non_diegetic_music: Light, playful plucked ukulele notes at a moderate tempo with soft glockenspiel accents, fading out gently during the final sigh.
